newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse okays Sarantis rights & scrip issue.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse okays Sarantis rights & scrip issue.

text.p: The Athens bourse said on Wednesday it had approved the 3.66 billion drachma rights issue by cosmetics producer Sarantis.
Sarantis will issue 1,526,250 new common bearer shares at 2,400 drachmas. The terms will be one new share per four outstanding.
The company also got Athens bourse approval on a bonus issue of 610,500 common bearer shares. The terms will be one bonus share per 10 outstanding.
Sarantis will use proceeds to partly pay for the acquisition of unlisted Sanitas-Sanitas SA and improve its capital structure. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
